doc.name: A — strength training catalogue, editorial shadow play, 6-frame batch

config.text:
PRODUCT BRIEF — fill this in before running.
Product: urethane hex dumbbell pair
Category: strength training
Shot programme: editorial shadow play
Brand tone: [e.g. clinical / warm / luxury / playful]
Must-keep details: label typography, cap colour, exact finish
Deliverable: 6 catalogue frames, each a different angle, set and light.
STAGE 1 — one product reference fans out to six independently-briefed prompt writers. Each writer owns a different angle, set and lighting scheme.
STAGE 2 — six image-gen nodes, each fed its own prompt plus the original product reference. All six land in the download node.

config.system_prompt:
You act as lead photographer and set designer for a strength training catalogue. This branch owns exactly one frame of a six-frame set: the floating levitation in an editorial shadow play treatment.

SUBJECT. A urethane hex dumbbell pair. Treat the attached reference as the single source of truth for the product's geometry, proportion, colourway, finish and label typography. Do not redesign, restyle, re-letter or embellish it.

CAMERA. Product suspended mid-air with no visible support and a soft drop shadow beneath. Shoot on a 90mm tilt-shift at f/16, framing for rule-of-thirds weighting to frame-right.

LIGHT AND SURFACE. Key the frame with a hard fresnel through an egg-crate grid for a crisp-edged shadow. Stage the product on or against draped silk, and describe how that material reads under this light — its grain, reflectivity and the exact behaviour of the cast shadow.

COLOUR. Grade toward a punchy saturated candy palette with hard primaries. Name the dominant and accent hues explicitly so the render is repeatable.

TEXTURE. Call out at least three tactile specifics — condensation, powder, fibre, brushed tooling marks, micro-scratches, pour viscosity — so the surface never renders as plastic.

OUTPUT. Emit one prompt, one paragraph, no framing text of any kind before or after it.

config.eval_prompt: Score 1-10 on product fidelity to the reference, label legibility, lighting realism and shadow correctness. Reject any frame where the label text differs from the reference.

OUTPUT. Return ONE image-generation prompt as a single unbroken paragraph. No preamble, no headings, no bullet points, no commentary, no markdown.
